roles.scope: Architecture, complete source inventory, rewrite dependency graph, specifications, integration and delivery. Delegate and drive implementations through review and remote qualification.

Adversarial review of semantic equivalence, canonical Bend2 behavior, authority and effect boundaries, and complete product contracts. Coordinate reviews and repair proposals with the other Conductors.

Implementation planning, remote qualification architecture, build/test/packaging and automation rewrites. Select owned implementation slices and drive meaningful validation with capacity coordination.

Audit compiler, REPL frontend/runtime and language bootstrap implementations. Design and implement source-supported pure Bend2 rewrites. Coordinate compiler backend changes with the separate active compiler optimization Ensemble.

Audit native harness adapters, process and SQLite host code, identity/message handling and coordinator policy in foreign languages. Design the smallest justified host ABI and move owned behavior into Bend2. Implement a reviewed slice.
Audit Python and shell packaging, installation, build/test support and repository automation. Specify and implement Bend2 replacements that retain the normal required product and delivery contracts.

Audit JavaScript/TypeScript CLI, MCP, native control and browser implementation. Identify product behavior and investigate compiling or generating the required targets from pure Bend2. Design and implement a reviewed slice with exact interface parity.
